name: Twin Peaks
demographics: Twin Peaks serves an exceptionally affluent community with households earning an average of $178,123 annually within a 3-mile radius, and average home values exceeding $1 million at $1,077,473. The trade area encompasses over 90,000 residents with a strong daytime population of 94,375, indicating significant employment and commercial activity in the area. The center attracts families and professionals seeking convenient access to everyday services, fitness and wellness options, and diverse dining experiences, with over 3.3 million annual visits reflecting its role as a primary shopping destination for Poway's upscale residential community.
description: Twin Peaks is a thriving 207,741 square foot community shopping center strategically located at 14721-14905 Pomerado Road in Poway, California, serving one of San Diego County's most affluent communities. Anchored by Target and Amazon Fresh, this high-volume center offers a well-rounded mix of national retailers, local businesses, and service providers that cater to the daily needs of the surrounding population. The center features popular dining destinations including Luna Grill, The Original Pancake House, Ike's Love & Sandwiches, and Outback Steakhouse, alongside fitness options like CorePower Yoga and Burn Boot Camp. With over 30 established tenants ranging from Famous Footwear and Leslie's Pool Supplies to specialized services like Twin Peaks Dentistry, Poway Eyeworx Optometry, and Twin Peaks Veterinary Hospital, the center provides comprehensive shopping and service convenience. Drawing over 3.3 million visitors annually, Twin Peaks has established itself as a premier neighborhood destination in Poway's dense, affluent community where households earn an average of $178,123 and home values average over $1 million.
summary: Twin Peaks is a high-performing 207,741 square foot community center in affluent Poway, anchored by Target and Amazon Fresh with over 30 diverse tenants. The center attracts 3.3 million annual visits, serving a prosperous trade area with average household incomes of $178,123 and offering a comprehensive mix of retail, dining, fitness, and professional services.
